meta.source_primary: TradingView Japan screener (scanner.tradingview.com/japan/scan), filter: exchange=TSE, subtype=common, market_cap_basic>¥100,000,000,000 (¥1,000億), excluding industry='Real Estate Investment Trusts' (40 J-REITs) and preferred shares (3). Fields: name/description/sector/industry/market_cap_basic/close/price_earnings_ttm/non_gaap_price_to_earnings_per_share_forecast_next_fy(forward PE)/price_book_fq/dividends_yield_current/return_on_equity_fy/total_revenue_yoy_growth_fy/net_income_yoy_growth_fy/gross_margin_fy/operating_margin_fy/total_debt_fy/cash_n_short_term_invest_fq/total_shares_outstanding_current/price_52_week_high/price_52_week_low.
meta.source_secondary: yfinance (~/.venvs/v7bt/bin/python, batches of 20, 2s inter-batch sleep) used to sample-verify 40 stocks (stratified by market-cap quartile, 10 each); market cap/P-B/cash/shares/52w high-low deviations were within 5% median so TradingView values were kept for those fields; trailing PE, forward PE, ROE and dividend yield showed >5% median deviation (different consensus-estimate/fiscal-basis conventions between providers), so those four fields were re-fetched from yfinance for the full 939-stock universe (0 fetch errors).
meta.field_units_note: roe/revenue_growth/net_income_growth/gross_margin/operating_margin stored as fractions (e.g. 0.15 = 15%); dividend_yield stored as a percent number (e.g. 2.5 = 2.5%); price_book/trailing_pe/forward_pe are plain ratios.
meta.v1_comparison: Compared against the prior 476-stock universe (2022-02 TOPIX 500 skeleton + 6 patches, saved verbatim as _universe_v1_476.json): 474/476 (99.6%) found in this new universe. 2 misses: 4919 Milbon (current market cap ~¥98.9bn, now just under the ¥1,000bn threshold) and 8283 PALTAC (delisted 2026 via MediPal Holdings' completed TOB acquisition, a real corporate action consistent with the governance-lens narrative, not a data gap).
